1: Marelli Motori is a leading Italian manufacturer of generators, frequency converters and electric motors.
The company is headquartered in Arzignano, near Verona
Marelli Motori was acquired by Langley Holdings
fully integrated production of industrial-grade machines up to 13 MW, 15kV, and 50 tons.
